prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.7 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.1 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.60 s (2% below healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.30 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 789 W·min/l (106% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.8 % (48% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.7 bar (21% above healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
